AdroIT Technologies Innovative Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
Company Overview
AdroIT Technologies is a premier education and training organization committed to bridging the
skills gap between academia and industry. Founded in 2000, with a legacy of over 20 years of
innovation, AdroIT delivers high-impact training programs in partnership with IBM, Oracle, and
leading government skill missions. The company empowers students, professionals, and
institutions with globally recognized certifications and industry-ready skills.
Mission
To bridge the skill gap by providing relevant, industry-ready training with continued academic
support. AdroIT provides experiential, hands-on, and use-case-based training that prepares
students and professionals for real-world challenges, global certifications, and future-ready
careers.
Industrial Partnerships
AdroIT maintains official partnerships with IBM, Oracle, and AI Labs. These partnerships allow
AdroIT to offer globally recognized certifications and access to enterprise-grade tools and
learning resources. IBM Career Education and Oracle Workforce Development Program are key
collaboration tracks.
Services
Residential Training at Campus: Training programs delivered through institute-dedicated trainers
staying at the campus, enabling consistent content delivery and personalized support.
Online Training: Expert-curated online training with self-paced distance education to save time
and cost, covering a wide range of technology topics.
Staffing Solutions: Retained and contingency-based staffing services helping organizations
recruit employees meeting their specific needs.
Corporate Training: Customized corporate training programs designed to upskill employees with
practical knowledge and industry tools through expert-led sessions and real-world case studies.
Institutional Training: Quality training and continued support for academic upliftment, having
trained more than 1,00,000 individuals across the country.
Training and Internships: Face-to-face training and productive internship courses across various
technology domains with real-time industry case studies.
Course Catalog

AdroIT offers 23 specialized courses across 3 skill levels: Beginner, Intermediate, and
Advanced. All courses include hands-on projects, video lectures, assessments, and completion
certificates.
Beginner Level: Data analysis, web design and development, database management.
Intermediate Level: Big data systems, cloud platforms, IoT application development, Java
programming.
Advanced Level: Cloud security, advanced threat monitoring, identity management, compliance
frameworks.
Products
AdroIT Profice: An HR and performance management platform designed to recognize employee
efforts, enable accurate and transparent reporting, improve customer experience, and support
better decision-making at every level. Built to align contributions, streamline workflows, and
connect performance with purpose.
AdroIT Eduvate: An education and innovation platform combining technology and learning for
institutions.
AdroIT Prolearn: A learning platform focused on empowering professionals to exceed their
career goals.
Government Initiatives
AdroIT actively participates in government skill development missions and AICTE NEAT
(National Educational Alliance for Technology) programs, supporting national skill development
goals and bridging the gap between academic learning and industry requirements.
